# Roof rack finishes and durability

## Summary

Clean bare metal with strong solvent, sand rough spots, and consider Por15 for rust sealing. [t419]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Clean the bare metal thoroughly with a strong solvent to remove natural oils.
2. Sand down any rough spots or imperfections on the surface.

_Procedure reported by [t419]._

## Tools

- [Partial] Strong solvent [t419]

## Tips & gotchas

- Consider using Por15 as a hard-surface paint that seals rust well, then top coat with spray enamel for UV stability. [t419]
- [Partial] If powder coating locally, expect to pay by the hour since shops must sandblast and prep the metal themselves. [t419]
